channel.title: Pier & Point · Pier 70 Parcels F/G
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Pier 70 Parcels F/G (Pier 70), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Parcels F/G: The 2033 date on this record was drawn as an expected completion. The Port's 2017 staff report calls it an outside date in the Development Agreement's Schedule of Performance (Phase 2 within 16 years of approval), not a construction schedule. It is now labelled a legal deadline and no longer moves this record's status on the map or the timeline.

Source: https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Item%209B%20Pier%2070%20Approval%20092217.pdf.

item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Parcels F/G: Parcels F/G are now described as flexible (Commercial-Office or Residential in the D4D) and the map shows the use as mixed, instead of commercial office/life science. The six-story cap is stated as applying to commercial buildings only, an uncited 410,000 sq ft brochure figure was dropped, and the summary says F and G are split only in the Maximum Residential scenario. The 2033 completion milestone is now a soft 2017 outside date that down market delay has tolled and Port Item 11A proposes to reset, and the Item 11A milestone is dated to the Aug 7, 2026 staff report. The map notes no longer claim the site was never subdivided by the Assessor. The D4D citation no longer calls it an 'adopted' document, and the Mayor's signing entry now states the Board of Supervisors' first-reading vote on Oct 31, 2017 and final passage on Nov 14, 2017.

item.title: Milestone · Pier 70 Parcels F/G: Port staff report (memo dated Aug 7, 2026) for the Aug 11, 2026 Port Commission meeting (informational item 11A) describes proposed DDA amendments: parcel-specific outside dates, a Project-wide affordable rate of no less than 20% (327 stand-alone affordable units kept), 65-to-90 ft height increases on certain residential parcels, developer return cut from 18% to 14%, and a new phasing plan (Aug 7, 2026)
